facts.F17: Preservation pin carrier (D-9, E9): StartUpRegistrationsPreservationTest in Tests/Architecture, a craft target, not an oracle or support: nwdes freezes oracle and support bytes at approval, and S2 must change its seam line (RegisterReports gone) and S3 deletes it. The S1 crafter writes it as the first commit on the pre-B1 revision, baseline captured there and observed green before any line moves; the slice and candidate reviews judge it. Seam: WebApplication.CreateBuilder with EnvironmentName Testing, then RegisterServices(builder) and RegisterReports(builder.Services) by reflection as Main calls them; only the descriptors those calls add (the suffix after the builder own) are projected. Projection per service type: the ordered list of (lifetime, service key, implementation), where implementation is ImplementationType, else the instance type, else for a factory the delegate declared return type plus the ordered service types it asks of a recording IServiceProvider that answers nothing (the closure class and method name are left out: they change when a line moves). The baseline is written out inline by full type name, never computed at test time.
facts.F18: Composition-root rule, one oracle file per slice (nwdes approval freezes each slice bytes, so no slice edits an earlier one): S1 CompositionRootNamesModulesOnlyThroughTheirModuleArchUnitTest lists FlowMetrics, Forecasting, Promises, Licensing, Access; S2 CompositionRootNamesTheOtherModulesOnlyThroughTheirModuleArchUnitTest lists WorkItems, TrackerIntegration, Refinement, Reports, OrganisationSetup; together they are the ten-context rule. Each asserts, per listed context: its <X>Module exists in Lighthouse.Backend.Modules.<X> with Add<X>; only Program names it; Program registers no type of that context, where registers means the type is a generic argument of a call to an IServiceCollection registration extension (Add*, TryAdd*, Configure*, AddHostedService) or of GetService/GetRequiredService, read from the IL of Program and its compiler-made nested types; allowed: the handler block entries and the order-kept registrations of that context, by full name, compared both ways. The call reading is a new support CompositionRootRegistrations written with the S1 oracle and only read afterwards. S3 ProgramNamesModulesOnlyArchUnitTest: every type of the ten contexts that Program names at all (IlDependencies.DependentsIn over Program) is a <X>Module, a handler of the block, an order-kept registration, or a measured host set-up type; RED until the strays move.
facts.F19: Host set-up type versus stray (B3 list): a host set-up type is a module type Program needs outside the container registrations to set the host up: authentication scheme handlers and selectors in ConfigureAuthentication, MVC filters in AddControllers, the HTTP client names of ConfigureServices, and reads in PrintSystemInfo. A stray is any other module-internal name Program keeps, such as the Tracker integration OAuth provider check EnsureOAuthProvidersRegistered names (text measure at 49552e47a, noisy); a stray moves behind a <X>Module method called at the same point. The B1 acceptance designer measures the names from the IL; the S3 acceptance designer writes the list from that measure. If the measure leaves no stray after S2, S3 has no RED and goes back to the host.

facts.F20: Formal verification (D-16 confirmed): No model for container equivalence, handler order or the composition-root rule: there is no shared mutable state between actors, no multi-step protocol, no concurrency or crash window; each claim is a relation over closed finite sets (descriptors per service type, IL references of one type) executed exhaustively by the pin, the order pin and the rules. No checker is selected, so none is probed. No liveness claim: start-up registration is one synchronous pass with nothing that must eventually happen. PBT: not applicable, the domains are closed and finite and are enumerated whole.
